description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data entries across different categories within the Darija Open Dataset. The chart contains five slices representing distinct data types. The largest slice, colored light green, is labeled “Pending Translations” and comprises approximately 45,387 entries. A blue slice labeled “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” contains 30,000 entries. The next slice, colored orange, is labeled “Moroccan Names” and contains 23,108 entries. A smaller, yellow slice is labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)”. The smallest slice, colored a darker blue, is labeled “Extra + Augmented Data”. The chart includes a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest based on the number of entries represented.
